postconditions.statement: map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl staged/tracked; nothing else under map/ tracked

m4-freshness-test.title: Write and prove the map_tree_freshness test
m4-freshness-test.imperative: In tests/test_code_map.py write test(s) selected by `-k 'map_tree_freshness'` asserting the committed map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl are byte-identical to a fresh `build` into a scratch --out/--artifacts. TDD: first observe it fail against a deliberately stale map/INDEX.md (attest c1 with the RED evidence), then restore freshness and observe it pass. Separately, prove the check can fail for real: temporarily add a top-level function to a mapped module outside scripts/code_map (e.g. scripts/agent_work_root.py), rerun the selector and confirm RED, then revert byte-clean and confirm with `git diff --quiet -- <path>` (not `git status --porcelain`). Report the exact RED output. Attest c2.

preconditions.satisfied_by: landing zone tracked: exactly map/INDEX.md + map/ids.jsonl

postconditions.statement: TDD red: test observed failing against a deliberately stale committed index -- manual attest
postconditions.satisfied_by: TDD red observed: staled the committed map/INDEX.md (appended a marker line), ran -k map_tree_freshness, test_map_tree_freshness_root_index_matches_a_fresh_build FAILED (AssertionError, entity-count mismatch in the diff). Restored map/INDEX.md byte-for-byte from a pre-stale backup; test passed again. Separately, my own edits to tests/test_code_map.py (adding this test class) legitimately moved the corpus's entity count, so map/ was rebuilt fresh (7/7 check) and re-staged before finalizing -- committed index is current as of this gate's own diff.

postconditions.statement: test green against the fresh, tracked map/; mutation-kill proven RED then reverted byte-clean

constraints: the RED proof must be a real command run, not an assertion that one would fail
revert verified via `git diff --quiet`, not `git status --porcelain` (core.autocrlf=true false-negatives on porcelain)

m5-suite-and-commit.imperative: Run the full test suite and confirm it is green (expect baseline 1838 passed, 2 skipped, 701 subtests, 0 failed plus the new freshness test(s)). Commit the work with explicit paths (no `git add -A`). Do not push, open a PR, or merge. Write .agent-work/issue-456/crew-handoffs/gs-implement-RESULT.md per the template, including which gate owns keeping the committed entry point fresh. Attest c2.

preconditions.satisfied_by: freshness test written, TDD red/green shown, mutation-kill proven RED then byte-clean revert

why_trail.why: Handoff complete: task (cherry-pick 4 skills files + land 2-file stable map entry point + freshness test), scope, exclusions (scripts/code_map/*.py, no merge, no push, read-only corpora), required evidence, TDD test mode, close criteria all present. Landing-zone-measurement.md read: 2-file root zone (map/INDEX.md + map/ids.jsonl) measured stable via a body-edit/shape-edit arm pair; 116-file zone is not.

Cherry-picked exactly the four skills paths from d102c05 via git checkout d102c05 -- <paths> (never a wholesale cherry-pick). git diff d102c05 scoped to those four paths is empty (0 lines) -- they carry exactly d102c05's 9-line diff. .agent-work/explore-code-map/cycle-3.json untouched (git diff --quiet). Corrected the plan's check text mid-gate: diffing the whole skills/ tree against d102c05 was wrong because the branch has legitimately diverged from d102c05 elsewhere in skills/ via unrelated later gates (g5-g8); scoped the check to the four target paths only.

python -m scripts.code_map build --root . then check --root . run clean: 114 modules, 3893 entities, 4008 pages; check reports 7/7 (no-empty-pages, page-accounting, refs-line-self-consistent, entity-symbol-join, page-location-matches-content, inbound-attribution, deterministic-rebuild) and exits 0. map/ is untracked scratch at this point; only map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl get tracked in the next gate.

Added .gitignore rule (map/* then !map/INDEX.md !map/ids.jsonl) and fixed the now-stale adjacent comment that claimed the whole page tree was committed. Staged explicit paths only: git add map/INDEX.md map/ids.jsonl .gitignore -- never -A/.  git ls-files map/ shows exactly map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl, nothing else. Noted: 'LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it' warning on both files -- this is exactly the autocrlf hazard CREW_CONTEXT.md and the handoff warn about, so the freshness test in m4 must normalize newlines rather than compare raw working-tree bytes.

-k map_tree_freshness collects 2 tests and both pass against the fresh, tracked map/. Mutation-kill proven: added a top-level function _map_tree_freshness_probe to scripts/agent_work_root.py (a mapped module outside scripts/code_map/), did NOT rebuild map/, reran the selector -> test_map_tree_freshness_root_index_matches_a_fresh_build FAILED (916 vs 915 entities in the diff, confirming the mutation moved the root index as predicted by landing-zone-measurement.md's Arm B). Reverted the mutation; git diff --quiet -- scripts/agent_work_root.py exits 0 (byte-clean, not git status --porcelain which false-negatives under this repo's core.autocrlf=true). Reran selector -> both tests PASSED again. Comparison is over text.read_text() normalized content, not raw bytes, per CREW_CONTEXT.md's Windows guidance (git add already warned of CRLF conversion on map/INDEX.md).

amendments.reason: m1's check text diffed the whole skills/ tree against d102c05, but the branch has independently diverged from d102c05 elsewhere in skills/ via unrelated gate work (cartographer/map-model.md, commander/COMMANDER_SPINE, interrogator/reviewer templates) that predates this gate and is out of scope. Scope the check to exactly the four cherry-picked paths, matching the handoff's own close-criteria intent.
